# Sutcliffe Trading

Sutcliffe Trading is a New Zealand timber merchant established in 1988. The company supplies New Zealand-grown Radiata Pine through established sawmill and manufacturing relationships.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/) — company overview, timber range, common buyer questions and contact paths.
- [Timber](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/timber) — Radiata Pine product groups, applications, grades and current sourcing pathways.
- [About Sutcliffe Trading](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/about) — company history, founder Bill Sutcliffe and CEO George Harman.
- [Sustainability](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/sustainability) — FSC® certification, carbon information and responsible sourcing.
- [Contact](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/contact) — timber enquiry requirements and direct contact details.

## Core product groups
- [Manufacturing timber](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/timber/manufacturing) — feedstock for wood processors and timber manufacturers.
- [Building and construction timber](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/timber/building-construction) — structural, building, finishing and specialist construction products.
- [Outdoor and landscaping timber](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/timber/outdoor-landscaping) — treated and purpose-made timber for fencing, retaining, decking and landscaping.
- [Dunnage timber](https://www.sutcliffetrading.com/timber/dunnage) — timber for freight, shipping, load support and industrial transport.

## Service area
New Zealand, with nationwide timber supply.
